# Femi Orimoloye — Digital Authority Reference

## Identity and positioning
Femi Orimoloye (formal name shown in professional source material: Orimoloye Oluwafemi) is positioned as a strategic human-capital and people-strategy professional. The brand connects people strategy, talent, total rewards, employee experience and organisational effectiveness to organisational performance and business outcomes.

Official tagline: People Strategy. Organizational Performance. Lasting Impact.

## Supported professional areas
- Human-capital leadership and strategic HR business partnering
- Total rewards, compensation and benefits, job evaluation and pay equity
- Workforce planning, talent acquisition, leadership development and succession
- Employee engagement, experience, inclusion and culture initiatives
- HR operations, shared services, process improvement and systems
- Programme development, mentorship and onboarding

## Career contexts in supplied profile
- Head, Program Development, Empowered Futures (June 2025–present in supplied profile)
- HR Program Consultant, PRUDE Inc. (February 2025–present in supplied profile)
- Head, Human Capital Management & Total Rewards, Nigeria Inter-Bank Settlement Systems PLC (February 2022–November 2024)
- Manager, Reward & Shared Services, Interswitch Group (January 2020–January 2022)
- Senior Strategic HR Business Partner, Access Bank Plc (October 2018–December 2019)

## Selected reported outcomes from supplied profile
- Cross-border compensation and benefits harmonisation across seven countries and 300+ roles at Interswitch; profile reports a 23% improvement in internal pay equity.
- Digital mentorship programme at Empowered Futures; profile reports 95% participant engagement and 90% programme completion in the first cycle.
- Graduate trainee programme at NIBSS; profile reports 100% retention.
- Leadership framework at NIBSS; profile reports a 12% improvement in managerial effectiveness.
- Shared-services efficiency and HR policy harmonisation; profile reports an 86% increase in efficiency.

These metrics are presented as profile-reported outcomes, not independently audited claims.

## Editorial and publication integrity
The Insights archive includes nine original project-created editorial drafts spanning people strategy, total rewards, employee experience, workforce planning, pay equity, employee listening, HR technology, leadership capability and people analytics. They are not described as previously published work. No prior media appearance, speaking engagement, testimonial or external publication is invented.

## Insight articles
- [People Strategy Is a Business Design Problem](https://femiorimoloye.com/insights/people-strategy-is-a-business-design-problem/): When people decisions sit outside the operating model, organisations end up treating symptoms instead of designing for performance.
- [Total Rewards Is a System, Not a Payroll Line](https://femiorimoloye.com/insights/total-rewards-is-a-system-not-a-payroll-line/): Pay matters. So do fairness, clarity, benefits, recognition and the trust employees place in the decisions behind them.
- [The Employee Experience Is Built Into the Processes](https://femiorimoloye.com/insights/the-employee-experience-is-built-in-the-processes/): Culture is shaped not only by what leaders say, but by the ordinary systems through which people enter, work, grow and get support.
- [Workforce Planning Begins With the Work, Not the Headcount](https://femiorimoloye.com/insights/workforce-planning-begins-with-the-work/): A credible workforce plan starts with the work the organisation must deliver, the capabilities it needs and the constraints it must manage.
- [Pay Equity Requires More Than a Salary Comparison](https://femiorimoloye.com/insights/pay-equity-requires-more-than-a-salary-comparison/): A credible pay-equity review examines job context, decision rules, reward structures and the quality of the data—not only salary figures.
- [Employee Listening Matters Only When It Changes Decisions](https://femiorimoloye.com/insights/employee-listening-matters-only-when-it-changes-decisions/): Surveys and listening channels earn trust when employees can see how their input informs priorities, action and follow-through.
- [HR Technology Should Simplify the Work Around People](https://femiorimoloye.com/insights/hr-technology-should-simplify-work/): Technology creates value when it reduces friction, clarifies ownership and improves decisions—not when it digitises a broken process.
- [Leadership Capability Is Built in Everyday Systems](https://femiorimoloye.com/insights/leadership-capability-is-built-in-everyday-systems/): Leadership development is stronger when the organisation’s routines, incentives and decision rights reinforce the behaviours it expects from leaders.
- [The Metrics That Matter Connect People Activity to Business Outcomes](https://femiorimoloye.com/insights/people-metrics-must-connect-to-business-outcomes/): Useful people reporting explains what is changing, why it may matter and which decision the evidence should inform.
